I added the constant `FREEBUFF_TAKEOVER_MARKER = "Freebuff is already running"` and inserted a new check inside the startup loop to look for that marker and, if found, trigger the takeover logic (by sending an Enter key to the tmux session). The linting and unit tests all passed after those edits, and I cleaned up the temporary debug session (`fb-debug`) to avoid any stray processes that could interfere with the next run.

```

```

With the new marker detection, the code should now send an Enter key to take over the existing session, allowing the probe to proceed.

To confirm this, I’ll re‑execute the same probe command, but this time I’ll give it a longer timeout (480 seconds) to be generous, in case the takeover takes a bit longer. Running this in the background is useful because the probe can take a minute or two, and I don’t want to block the agent while waiting for the output.

The exact command I’ll use mirrors the earlier successful pattern:
